

===  cmavo: nai (NAI) ===

====  Proposed Definition ====

Negate cmavo. Causes the meaning of the attached cmavo to be the negative of the original meaning. See individual words for how this interacts with them.

====  Proposed Tag ====

====  See Also ====

* na
* ja'ai

====  Proposed Keywords ====

* negate
* negative

====  Usage Examples ====

;.i.ienai mi na blanu:"[[Disagreement|Disagreement]] I am not blue."

;.i.uinaicai lo mi gerku cu morsi:"[[Extreme unhappiness|Extreme unhappiness]] My dog is dead!"

===  cmavo: ja'ai (NAI) ===

====  Proposed Definition ====

Affirm cmavo. Explicitly denies a negative on the attached cmavo. Used for answering ``pei'' questions, and with logical connectives. See individual words for how this interacts with them.

====  Proposed Tag ====

====  See Also ====

* na
* nai

====  Proposed Keywords ====

* affirm
* affirmative

====  Usage Examples ====

====  Notes ====

This is a proposed new cmavo.
